author: sanaa-hamel-microsoft
body:
[ORT 1.27.0](https://onnxruntime.ai/roadmap) will be released soon, pending successful validation. Release candidate builds are available now for testing. If you encounter issues, please report them by responding in this issue.

CUDA 12 packages are deprecated. Please update to CUDA 13 packages.

Release branch: [rel-1.27.0](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/tree/rel-1.27.0)
Release manager: @sanaahamel_microsoft
## Python Packages
